articles.author: Teri Schultz
articles.title: EU rolls out red carpet to Canada to become its first 'associate member' - NPR
articles.description: The European Union's top official backs the Canadian prime minister's push for his country to become the bloc's first "associate member," as Brussels seeks to deepen ties amid pressure from the U.S.
articles.content:
BRUSSELS The European Union is proposing a new kind of relationship with Canada, one that could make it the EU's first-ever "associate member" a model that does not currently exist.
